title: Loop validation rule-code registry — v1 (frozen)
description: Stable rule codes are API (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §19): 'their meaning cannot be silently repurposed; severity may change only through a documented ruleset version.' This registry covers the 15 detection classes required by §7, the 6 package-import invariants from WP-8a's hard-invariant list (renamed into the declared namespace format), and the 3 new P0 controls from 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §B3 (invisible-Unicode rejection, prompt static scanning, egress allowlist) plus the fixture-staleness rule from §D. A validation report MUST include this rulesetVersion, the semantic digest of the definition being validated, the surface implementation identity, and findings sorted deterministically (by namespace, then code, then nodeId/edgeId).

namespaces.meaning: package, path, digest, secret, payload policy

rules.messageTemplate: Duplicate identity '{id}' used by more than one {objectType}.
rules.remediation: Assign each node/edge/slot/test/verifier a stable, unique ID within the definition.

rules.messageTemplate: Attempted mutation of installed package bytes for release {loopId}@{semanticVersion} (digest {packageDigest}).
rules.remediation: Installed releases are immutable; create a forked draft to edit (IMP-006, LIN-001).

rules.messageTemplate: Missing explicit start node or no terminal node is reachable.
rules.remediation: Declare a start node and ensure at least one terminal node is reachable from it.

rules.messageTemplate: Node '{nodeId}' is unreachable from the start node.
rules.remediation: Connect the node into the graph or remove it.

rules.messageTemplate: Gateway '{gatewayId}' is not exhaustive and declares no default or terminal-failure path.
rules.remediation: Add a default edge or an explicit terminal-failure path.

rules.messageTemplate: Cycle {cyclePath} has no statically visible bound (budget, counter, or runtime hard limit).
rules.remediation: Add a bounding budget/counter to the cycle, or declare it a bounded repeat group.

rules.messageTemplate: Required parameter '{param}' is unbound at {location}.
rules.remediation: Bind the parameter to a slot, constant, or upstream output before packaging.
rules.sourceObligation: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §7 'unbound required parameters'; LOOP-004 vs PKG-008 resolved in favour of LOOP-004 (10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §F)

rules.messageTemplate: Schema at '{path}' is not valid JSON Schema draft 2020-12 (or later ratified version), or is incompatible with its declared usage.
rules.remediation: Fix the schema or its draft/version declaration.

rules.messageTemplate: Node '{nodeId}' requests capability '{capabilityId}', which is unavailable or prohibited on this target/flavor.
rules.remediation: Remove the requirement, gate the node behind a compatibility check, or request a capability the target actually provides.

rules.messageTemplate: Binding for slot '{slotId}' would WIDEN authority beyond the package's declared request ({requested} -> {resolved}).
rules.remediation: A binding may only narrow requested authority, never widen it (CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY_MODEL; IMP-005).

rules.messageTemplate: External-effect node '{nodeId}' declares no budget dimension (steps/wall-clock/tokens/cost/tool-calls).
rules.remediation: Declare at least the minimum budget dimensions for any node with external side effects.

rules.messageTemplate: Recursive subloop at '{nodeId}' has no statically visible depth limit.
rules.remediation: Declare an explicit maximum recursion depth.

rules.messageTemplate: Destructive path through '{nodeId}' has no compensation behavior and no explicit non-compensability acknowledgement.
rules.remediation: Declare compensation behavior, or explicitly acknowledge non-compensability.
rules.sourceObligation: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §4, §7 'non-compensated destructive paths lacking explicit acknowledgement'

rules.messageTemplate: Terminal state claims SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED but verifier '{verifierId}' (requiredForSuccess=true) has no passing result tied to this run's inputs/digest/artifacts.
rules.remediation: Either attach a passing required verifier result or report SUCCEEDED_UNVERIFIED.
rules.sourceObligation: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §16 'MUST NOT claim SUCCEEDED_VERIFIED unless...'; §7 'unverified success paths where verified success is claimed'

rules.messageTemplate: File '{path}' matches a secret-like pattern (API key, private key, token).
rules.remediation: Remove the secret; secrets are resolved by reference at runtime, never embedded (§25).
rules.sourceObligation: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §7 'secret-like package material'; secret scanning by named tool (gitleaks) per 02_DECISION_ANNOTATIONS §4b FB-RAT-MKT-007 correction

rules.messageTemplate: File '{path}' is a forbidden executable payload (DEX/JAR/native binary/script interpreter directive/plugin installer).
rules.remediation: Marketplace packages are declarative-only; reference a capability ID instead (PKG-003 REJECTED alternative).

rules.messageTemplate: Path or canonicalization error at '{path}': {detail}.
rules.remediation: See floop-container-format.v1.json pathRules and canonicalization.v1.json numberPolicy.

rules.messageTemplate: Import/preview pipeline observably invoked model, tool, shell, remote, or device access for node '{nodeId}' before activation.
rules.remediation: Parsing, validation, and preview MUST NOT execute package content (IMP-002).
rules.sourceObligation: WP-8a hard invariant IMP-002; LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §25 'Import never executes package content'

rules.messageTemplate: Package import for '{loopId}' was PARTIAL; partial import is unsupported for PACKAGE_IMPORT profile.
rules.remediation: A LoopPackage import is all-or-nothing; re-acquire a complete package (contrast with INT-007's companion-data partial-import support).

rules.messageTemplate: Model- or human-visible string at '{location}' contains disallowed invisible/control Unicode ({codepointClass}) not individually declared and justified in the manifest.
rules.remediation: Remove the codepoint(s) or add an individually justified manifest declaration; the finding renders with a visible badge and an escape view and CANNOT be dismissed as a warning.
rules.sourceObligation: 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §B3 rule 1 (Tags U+E0000-U+E007F, bidi U+202A-U+202E / U+2066-U+2069, zero-width/format U+200B-U+200F / U+FEFF, Private Use Areas)

rules.messageTemplate: Node '{nodeId}' requests network egress capability without a declared destination host allowlist, or targets a host outside its declared allowlist.
rules.remediation: Declare the exact egress destination(s) in the manifest; a granted External capability remains scoped to declared hosts.

rules.messageTemplate: Heuristic prompt-risk scan flagged '{location}': {indicatorClass} (model-directed imperative / exfiltration verb+destination / sensitive-path reference / markdown-comment-smuggled instruction).
rules.remediation: Human review required before publish; this is a heuristic flag, not proof of malice (OWASP MCP03:2025 indicator list).
rules.sourceObligation: 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §B3 rule 2 (prompt-text static scanning at build and import)

rules.messageTemplate: Target constraint at '{location}' cannot be satisfied by any declared execution target class.
rules.remediation: Relax the constraint or add a satisfying target class.

rules.messageTemplate: Update {fromDigest} -> {toDigest} widens authority, weakens a verifier, adds an external target, adds a secret slot, increases budget, or adds a destructive path without fresh approval.
rules.remediation: Any of these changes requires fresh user approval even for a patch release (§22); present the authority-diff summary.
rules.sourceObligation: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §22; WP-8a hard invariant IMP-008; LIN-005

rules.messageTemplate: Node '{nodeId}' has no required fixture for its declared node category, and no explicit test-coverage declaration.
rules.remediation: Attach a fixture, or (marketplace listings only) an explicit bare test-coverage declaration rendered as a visible no-tests badge.
rules.sourceObligation: 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §F 'LOOP-004 vs PKG-008' — LOOP-004 (fixtures) wins for P0; bare declaration allowed only for marketplace listings

rules.messageTemplate: Fixture ({nodeId}, {iterationIndex}, {callIndex}) has a recorded prompt digest that no longer matches the current node prompt.
rules.remediation: Fixture is marked STALE, not silently missing or silently matching; regenerate the fixture against the current prompt.
rules.sourceObligation: 10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §D fixture-keying recommendation: key on (nodeId, iterationIndex, callIndex) with a non-binding recorded prompt digest

rules.messageTemplate: Fork of '{parentLoopId}'@{parentDigest} is missing parent attribution.
rules.remediation: Record parent release identity, applied upstream changes, and authorship per ForkLineage.

rules.messageTemplate: Declared license '{license}' is incompatible with parent release '{parentLoopId}' license '{parentLicense}'.
rules.remediation: Choose a compatible license or remove the derivative claim.
rules.sourceObligation: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §2.9; P1 gate 'lineage and license checks for derivatives'
